fact: A technical team from the INTERPOL WAPIS/AFIS Programme visited Sierra Leone in the week before publication and met the Sierra Leone Police and the European Union Delegation on the implementation and advancement of WAPIS/AFIS and the deployment of biometric technologies; the article reports discussions only, and no new deployment, station or workstation count.
title: INTERPOL WAPIS/AFIS Team Engages Sierra Leone Police, EU Delegation to Strengthen Regional Security Cooperation
